info.name: AuroraX Application.wadl Data Products Search API

description.content: ## Overview This webpage is an interactive documentation interface for the AuroraX RESTful API. This API is used by several applications including the AuroraX Conjunction Search, Event Explorer, Keogramist, PyAuroraX, and IDL-AuroraX. You can view these applications and libraries at https://aurorax.space and https://github.com/aurorax-space. Detailed documentation about the AuroraX platform and examples of using this API can be found at https://docs.aurorax.space. Below, we outline the major categories of endpoints available for use: | Interface | Description | | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Accounts | Operations relating to user accounts, API keys, and saved user data | | Authentication | Authentication using an email address and password, or an API key | | Availability | Retrieve information describing what data is in the database | | Data Sources | Interact with data sources | | Conjunctions | Search for conjunctions between multiple sets of data sources | | Ephemeris | Search and manage ephemeris data associated with a data source | | Data Products | Search and manage data products data associated with a data source | | Utils | Utilities, such as describing a search query in an SQL-like format | ## Authentication AuroraX allows for two methods of authentication: 1. Authenticate via username and password using the /authenticate endpoint to obtain an access token. Access tokens need to be sent on every request for secure resources. Inactive access tokens timeout after 30 minutes. 2. Authenticate using an API key sent in the request header (key called 'x-aurorax-api-key') More information can be found here. ## Errors This API uses standard HTTP status codes to indicate the success or failure of the API call. When an error occurs, the body of the response will be JSON and contain an error code and message. All errors will respond with this format: ``` { "error_code": "DUPLICATE", "error_message": "There was a duplicate record found. No changes were made." } ```
